headline: Names a Baytown, Texas post office building after Specialist Keith Erin Grace, Jr.
what_it_does: This law renames the U.S. Postal Service facility at 601 West Baker Road in Baytown, Texas, as the "Specialist Keith Erin Grace, Jr. Memorial Post Office." It is an honorary designation. It does not change how the post office operates, its services, or its staff.
when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on December 18, 2014, and the name took effect on that date.
